def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)

    colors = {grid[r][c] for r, c in cells}
    inner = min(colors, key=lambda color: sum(grid[r][c] == color for r, c in cells))
    inner_cells = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner]
    inner_top = min(r for r, c in inner_cells)
    inner_bottom = max(r for r, c in inner_cells)
    inner_left = min(c for r, c in inner_cells)
    inner_right = max(c for r, c in inner_cells)
    pad_top = inner_top - top
    pad_bottom = bottom - inner_bottom
    pad_left = inner_left - left
    pad_right = right - inner_right

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, top - pad_top), min(h, bottom + pad_bottom + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, left - pad_left), min(w, right + pad_right + 1)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
